title: The Early Impact of GDPR Compliance on Display Advertising: The Case of an Ad Publisher
eligible_reason: Single event date for all EU users (consent pop-up from April 18, 2018) versus non-EU users; no staggered adoption. Specification also carries multiple nonredundant additive and interacted fixed effects.
design_notes: Model 1 (Table 5): Y_acwpt = a + b Treated_c x Post_t + FE(ad) + FE(country) + FE(web page) + FE(ad slot position) + FE(date) + pairwise interaction FE (ad x country, ad x position, ad x web page, country x position, country x web page, position x web page) + e. Treated = EU IP address; Post = date >= April 18, 2018. Daily ad-country-web page-position panel, N = 3,920,212; SEs clustered at ad and web page. Table 5 coefficients: revenue per click -.022 (.00049); CTR -.00018 (.0000081); bid price -.025 (.00051); conversion rate -.0017 (.000042); advertisers' surplus -.0036 (.00014). Figure 3 daily event-study version, same single date.
screener_notes: Not eligible: one adoption date. Data are confidential ad-server data from an ad publisher (figures shown only in relative scale at the data provider's request). No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.
